description: Quality baselines that are pure measurements of the tree and that no gate asks a feature PR to edit (the obligation was moved to release mode or never existed). They are rewritten by the release refresh or a nightly job. Policy files (allowlists, gate-manifest, admission policies, provenance) and baselines a feature PR must legitimately edit together with code (typecheck/file-size/complexity ceilings, quality-baseline.json, eslint-suppressions.json) are deliberately NOT here. Plan 2026-11-13, phase 5.

categories.why: Relative weights for the Playwright shard packer. A spec without an entry already gets the median weight at run time; the completeness test (tests/unit/balance-e2e-shards.test.ts) runs in release mode only.
